title: Attack surface mapping + secrets rotation sync
body:
Meeting: Security engineering sync — attack-surface mapping + secrets rotation
Date: 2026-06-02 10:00-10:50 PT
Location: Zoom / #security-sync
Attendees: Lina (owner), Diego, Priya, Owen, Marta, Sam R. (SRE), Elaine (Infra)
Absentees: none noted

Purpose
- Weekly alignment to reconcile the latest vuln scan results with the attack-surface map and confirm next steps for secrets rotation and mitigations.
- Surface blockers for infra and rollout of automated rotations.

Agenda
1) Quick status: vuln scan + exposure delta (Lina)
2) Secrets rotation progress and blockers (Priya + Elaine)
3) Threat-modeling intake: new services + ownership (Diego)
4) Action items & owners, timeline (All)

Notes / Discussion
1) Vulnerability / exposure delta
- Last full scan (2026-05-31) flagged 14 new medium findings across staging and a couple of low findings in prod. Primary surface: third-party buildpack that pulls an outdated cert bundle.
- Temporary risk posture: medium-low — exploit path requires CI pipeline access plus specific build trigger.
- Prioritization decision: we will treat the buildpack findings as P2 until a patch is in place. Reason: likelihood is moderate and impact is limited to build artifacts. Ticket created: JIRA SEC-237 (owner: Owen). ETA for mitigation: 2026-06-09.
- Notes to SRE: add a temporary guardrail to disallow external buildpack pulls in dedicated pools. Action: Sam to add denylist rule in infra repo (PR referenced below).

2) Secrets rotation status (Priya / Elaine)
- Rolling key rotation: KMS key-rotation job ran on 2026-05-28 for non-prod; prod rotation is staged but blocked by two services that use long-lived HSM-backed credentials.
- Blocker detail: Service A (internal token broker) uses a custom HSM client that needs a minor lib bump to support new key metadata format. Elaine to coordinate with Service A owner (Marta) on testing harness.
- Temporary mitigation: rotate wrapper credentials and limit TTL to 12 hours for the tokens we can flip. We will not rotate the HSM-wrapped keys until client compatibility is verified.
- Action items:
  * Elaine: open PR for lib bump and provide test vector by 2026-06-04 (linked: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/128).
  * Priya: schedule blue/green roll for the token broker once lib bump lands, target window 2026-06-10 to 2026-06-12.
  * Marta: provide short test harness and confirm HSM client patch on 2026-06-06.

3) Threat modeling intake (Diego)
- New services to model this cycle: "routable-cache" (beta), "dedicated-edge-proxy" (experimental). Both increase public-facing surface area.
- Decision: create lightweight threat models (template-driven) for both, not full STRIDE workshop unless gaps appear. Diego will draft initial models and invite product owners.
- Questions surfaced: which data classes cross the cache boundary? Need catalog of data classification for the beta flows — Product to provide.

4) Incident & detection notes
- Recent detection pattern: repeated low-entropy auth attempts against internal gRPC endpoints from a misconfigured test runner. SRE adjusted firewall rules; we will add a small monitor for similar anomalous patterns.
- Action: Owen to add an alert in logs-based monitoring with a 1-hour lookback threshold and annotate playbook with response steps by 2026-06-05.

5) Risk exceptions / acceptance
- Exception requested by Platform for backward compatibility with older edge agents; current proposal: whitelisted agents for 30 days with compensating controls (IP restrictions, telemetry). Team agreed to provisional 14-day exception instead, revisit earlier if rollout delays occur. Ticket: INFRA-501 (owner: Sam).

Open questions / parking lot
- Should we adopt automated dependency scanning into the build orchestration step (blocking merges) or keep it advisory? Pros/cons discussed: developer friction vs earlier detection. Action: Lina to run a short poll across eng leads and report back by 2026-06-07.
- Secrets vault migration timeline — we need a concrete cutover window for service owners. Priya to publish proposed schedule by 2026-06-04.

Action items recap (owner — due)
- JIRA SEC-237: patch buildpack + deny external buildpack pulls in dedicated pools — Owen — 2026-06-09
- Infra PR for HSM client lib bump — Elaine — PR up by 2026-06-04 (https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/128)
- Token broker rotation plan & blue/green schedule — Priya — 2026-06-10
- HSM client test harness confirmation — Marta — 2026-06-06
- Logs alert for anomalous auth patterns & playbook entry — Owen — 2026-06-05
- Exception review for legacy edge agents — Sam — 2026-06-04 (temp 14-day exception)
- Lightweight threat models for routable-cache and dedicated-edge-proxy — Diego — draft by 2026-06-08
- Run eng-leads poll on dependency-scan policy — Lina — 2026-06-07

Decisions made
- Buildpack findings classified P2 and will be remediated within 1 week.
- Temporary 14-day exception granted for legacy edge agents with compensating controls.
- Use lightweight templates for new beta threat models to accelerate coverage.

Notes to self / work-in-progress items (informal)
- Follow up with Product on data classification for routable-cache — needed before threat model is useful.
- Consider adding a small canary to rotation pipeline to detect client incompatibility earlier (50 hosts in staging). Priya to prototype.

Next meeting
- Weekly cadence: next sync 2026-06-09 10:00 PT. Preliminary focus: post-rotation status, SEC-237 patch verification, threat-model drafts.

Appendix (quick refs)
- Scan snapshot summary: non-prod medium findings: 14, prod low findings: 2 (full CSV uploaded to Confluence).
- Relevant links: Confluence: Secrets Rotation Plan; GH PR: infra/128; Tickets: SEC-237, INFRA-501.

End of notes.

-- Lina
